name: Spearmint
summary: Fresh tea, and it spreads everywhere.
description: Spearmint is a vigorous mint with sweet, refreshing leaves.
usefulInformation: Use fresh in tea, salads, sauces and cold drinks.
healthBenefits: Its leaves contain aromatic compounds and antioxidants; human evidence for therapeutic effects is limited.
medicinalUses: Traditionally enjoyed as a soothing after-meal tea.

additionalInformation.growingTips: Grow in well-drained soil and adjust watering and sunlight to local conditions.
additionalInformation.harvesting: Harvest gently, leaving enough growth for the plant to recover.
additionalInformation.gardenNote: A useful addition to a kitchen and pollinator-friendly herb garden.
